facts.fact: The Federal High Court found Meskerem Abera (Ethio Neqat founder) guilty on two counts under Computer Crime Proclamation No. 958/2016 over two YouTube programmes, per her lawyer to BBC Amharic; sentencing was set for 11 November 2024.
The Computer Crime Proclamation No. 958/2016 was applied in a conviction by the Federal High Court.
